# Mathlib 4 Traced Dataset (LeanDojo Benchmark 4)

This directory vendors the formal Mathlib 4 proof step dataset extracted by LeanDojo.

## Contents (on Colab / local archive):
- `train.json` (~356 MB) - ~100k theorems with step-by-step tactics
- `val.json` (~6.2 MB) - 2,000 validation theorems
- `test.json` (~6.8 MB) - Benchmark evaluation split
- `corpus.jsonl` (~58 MB) - Complete premise definitions & locations
- `val_sample.json` (~150 KB) - 50-theorem sample tracked for local test pipelines

Source: `1337xyz1337xyz/leandojo-benchmark4-v10`
